gear_selection_method: Select first left-gripper upward crossing of 0.7 rad between 5.5 and 9.0 s. This identifies first assembly gear release after grasp, except episode 170616 where earlier pickup retry at 5.134 s is excluded. Interval starts 2.5 s before crossing, ends 0.2 s before it; all 17 were visually reviewed around crossing. Episode 170616 starts at 6.6 s to exclude pickup retry and regrasp. Endpoint is demonstrated near-contact before opening, not measured successful seating.
